C05 and C11 share the resignation-letter structure and substantial praise, but their language and sequencing are less closely aligned with the child's distinctive defense of character under controversy.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"your unfailing practice of placing the public interest above your own","parent_excerpt":"Your selfless and tireless devotion ... your total dedication to the nation's welfare","explanation":"Both characterize the resignation and prior service as selfless subordination of personal interests to the public good."},{"child_excerpt":"there is no one whose character, qualifications and selflessness I respect more highly","parent_excerpt":"you have ... my complete trust, confidence and respect","explanation":"The letters use closely parallel emphatic assurances of personal trust and respect for an official leaving amid controversy."},{"child_excerpt":"I accept it ... not only with personal sadness","parent_excerpt":"I accept your resignation with sadness","explanation":"This is a direct shared formulation for the operative acceptance of the resignation."},{"child_excerpt":"you will clearly have the admiration, respect and affection of your close associates in government","parent_excerpt":"You will be sorry missed by your colleagues on the staff and by the departments and agencies of the government","explanation":"Both immediately broaden the President's personal loss to the departing official's government colleagues and agencies."}]}
